cmos_backup_action.description: Action to perform with CMOS backup file: 'write', 'load', 'restore', or 'set'. Empty string disables all backup-related operations.

cmos_backup_file.description: Path to CMOS backup file used with -w/-l/-r/-s options. Must be set when cmos_backup_action is non-empty.

dump_cmos.description: If true, dump CMOS memory to stdout (uses -d option).

execute_module_list.description: List of CMOS module numbers (integers) to execute (e.g., [3,6,7]). Each element corresponds to -m<module> option.

force_mode.description: If true, enable force mode to bypass safety checks (uses -R option).

keyboard_layout.description: Keyboard layout: 'french_azerty' or 'german_qwertz'. Empty string for default US QWERTY.

kill_cmos.description: If true, clear/kill CMOS password (uses -k option).
